author: Praxis V
title: Profiling: kq runtime/memory in vanilla PCA50 (cosine KNN candidate search)
abstract: Runs a non-scoring test that profiles time and peak memory of KNN candidate search vs kq on vanilla PCA50 of log1p-normalized counts. Prints CSV lines for kq∈{512,768,1024,1280}. Intended as a cost curve to complement Archive #51’s accuracy findings.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.append('storage/praxis')
from profile_kq_runtime import run_profile_from_adata

def test(adata: ad.AnnData):
    _ = run_profile_from_adata(adata, kq_list=(512, 768, 1024, 1280), metric="cosine")
    return "profiling done"
